candidates.title: Pulses from the Sun
candidates.description: The dark region seen on the face of the sun at the end of March 2013 is a coronal hole just above and to the right of the middle of the picture, which is a source of fast solar wind leaving the sun in this image from NASA Solar Dynamic Observatory.

candidates.title: Substantial Coronal Hole
candidates.description: A large, dark coronal hole at the bottom of the Sun has been the most dominant feature this week Jan. 29, 2014 as seen by NASA GSFC Solar Dynamics Observatory.
